title: Saronic section heading
description: A section opener: small mono caption, a big light-weight title (32px on phones, 3.75vw on desktop, -2% tracking) and a large 450-weight lead on the left half, with an optional button parked at the right edge level with the title (under the title on phones).
notes: takes its colours from the surface it's on: put it inside a `dark` band for light text
